Seeds: 5; 95% Student-t intervals with 4 degrees of freedom. H2 and H3 read this cell (benchmark window-Bayes, horizon 1, step 30,000, grid ρ; H3 the gap at ρ = 0.6 and 0.8). Runs meeting the descriptive plateau rule: 1 of 5. Margins: ±1 pp of excess error, ±0.02 of gap. The verdict column applies the pre-registered rule to every row; outside the rows a hypothesis names it is descriptive or exploratory. Rows against Bayes measure the deviation from the full-information-set forecaster, which includes the information limit. A dash marks a diagnostic that is not defined for the row.
